title: Competitor Opportunity Map
summary: Confirm relevant search competitors, compare their supported demand and pages with the target domain, and rank opportunities to pursue, defer, or reject.

required_inputs.description: The target domain whose search competitors and opportunities should be evaluated.

scope.guidance: Discover and confirm no more than three relevant search competitors.

evidence_plan.condition: Use server discovery when the user has not supplied a sufficiently relevant competitor set.

completion_without.limitation: The method requires a user-supplied competitor set and must record that server discovery was unavailable.

evidence_plan.fallback: Use only user-supplied domains that can be confirmed against current result evidence; otherwise stop incomplete.

scope.guidance: Accept no more than three user-supplied competitor domains for confirmation.

completion_without.limitation: Competitors must instead be discovered and confirmed through the connected server.

evidence_plan.fallback: Use the server discovery path and reject domains that current search evidence does not confirm as relevant.

scope.guidance: Measure no more than twenty retained competitor queries that can change prioritization.

evidence_plan.condition: Use metrics only when qualitative demand evidence cannot distinguish or prioritize retained queries.

completion_without.limitation: Opportunity ranking remains qualitative and confidence must reflect missing quantitative evidence.

evidence_plan.fallback: Rank with current intent, coverage, relevance, and feasibility evidence.

scope.guidance: Validate no more than five representative queries across the retained opportunity clusters.

completion_without.limitation: The method cannot confirm search competitors, current intent, or result types without current result evidence.

evidence_plan.fallback: Return an incomplete opportunity set rather than infer competitor relevance from business labels alone.

scope.guidance: Read no more than one representative page per confirmed competitor and three target-domain pages.

evidence_plan.condition: Use page content when a retained cluster requires page-role, coverage, or differentiation evidence beyond current result snippets.

completion_without.limitation: Affected page-role and differentiation findings remain provisional and cannot support implementation-ready requirements.

evidence_plan.fallback: Keep the affected opportunity conditional and request a compatible page reader before implementation.

steps.instruction: Confirm the domain, business scope, market, audience, and constraints that determine competitor relevance.
Inspect current runtime cost and authorization for competitor discovery, keyword collection, and finalist validation.
Discover a bounded set of search competitors and reject entities that do not compete for the relevant audience or demand.
Collect bounded query evidence for confirmed competitors without equating all competitor rankings with target-domain opportunities.
Validate finalist demand, intent, result types, target-domain coverage, and material feasibility.
Inspect representative competitor and target pages to identify evidence-backed differentiation and page-role requirements.
Return ranked opportunity clusters with competitor, query, intent, page type, evidence, differentiation, effort, confidence, and disposition.

evidence_requirements: Competitor relevance is supported by observed search overlap and business context.
Every retained opportunity is validated against current result evidence and target-domain coverage.
Differentiation requirements are derived from evidence and user context, not copied from competitor prose.
Effort and confidence include the limits of available authority, product, and operational evidence.
stop_conditions: Stop or narrow when the market or business scope is too ambiguous to confirm competitors.
Stop before paid collection when authorization is insufficient.
Return an empty completed opportunity set when confirmed competitors produce no supported target opportunity.
completion_criteria: The confirmed competitor set and rejection logic are recorded.
Every included cluster has evidence, differentiation, effort, confidence, and disposition.
Target-domain overlap and page ownership are considered.
The result is bounded to the strongest supported opportunities.

bounds.sample_guidance: Compare a small confirmed competitor set and retain only opportunities that survive demand, intent, coverage, and feasibility checks.
